scoring_justification: DFT energies are physical quantities that can be reproduced with toolchain-dependent variations; comparing to paper's reference values with tolerances and trend checks is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference formation and segregation energies derived from Figure 7 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 7; values encoded in the reference solve.sh that reproduces the paper's DFT results.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the reference solve.sh which writes the exact numbers used as gold.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported computational results, approximated from Figure 7.

outputs.description: Average formation energy per Sn atom for M‑Sn surfaces (M=Ru,Ni,Pt) at coverages 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 ML.
Average subsurface‑to‑surface segregation energy per Sn atom for M‑Sn surfaces (M=Ru,Ni,Pt) at coverages 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 ML.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported energies to hidden reference values extracted from Figure 7 of the source paper. Tolerances absorb systematic differences between DFT codes and pseudopotentials while still requiring the correct relative ordering between metals.

trend_check.description: At each coverage, formation energy order must be Ru > Ni > Pt.
Segregation energy order must be Ru < Ni < Pt (more negative = stronger segregation).
